test_title: PYST 43: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of E. Only one person sits between A and C. F sits to the immediate left of E. A sits to the immediate right of D. C sits third to the right of B.

Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
**Given: **Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1. Only two people sit to the left of E.

2. Only one person sits between A and C.

3. F sits to the immediate left of E.

4. A sits to the immediate right of D.

5. C sits third to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46799242c48c6dfc69b3045088a033031786dd8f1b17d6eab1fb12b23320a708.png] 

Thus, B sits at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
